payload.description: Implement Python aether-protocol client. Packet encode/decode (JSON + binary), handshake, AODV routing, IContentService (publish/request/assemble), ChunkShuffle session. Publish to PyPI as aether-protocol.
Implement TypeScript aether-protocol client (browser + Node.js). Packet encode/decode, handshake, routing, content service, ChunkShuffle. Publish to npm as @bhengubv/aether-protocol.
Implement Rust aether-protocol crate. Packet encode/decode (serde_json), handshake, routing, content service, ChunkShuffle. Publish to crates.io as aether-protocol.
Implement Go aether-protocol module. Packet encode/decode, handshake, routing, content service, ChunkShuffle, aether-forge proxy daemon stub. Tag as go/v1.
Implement Kotlin aether-protocol library (Android + JVM). Packet encode/decode, handshake, routing, content service, ChunkShuffle. Publish to GitHub Packages as dev.aether:aether-protocol-kotlin.
Implement Swift aether-protocol package (iOS + macOS). Packet encode/decode, handshake, routing, content service, ChunkShuffle. Swift Package Manager.
Implement C aether-protocol library (embedded/headless). Packet encode/decode (cJSON), handshake, routing, content service. CMake build. Minimal dependencies for BLE-constrained devices.
Add cross-language ChunkBitmap wire-format tests. Read fixtures/content/chunk_bitmap_vectors.json in each language and assert expected_json matches. Adds to tests/cross-language/.

Add IAetherNetTelemetry.Publish() call sites throughout C# services. HandshakeService: publish AetherNetNodeEvent on join/left. RoutingService: publish AetherNetRouteEvent on discovery/failure. ContentService: publish AetherNetNetworkEvent on content complete.

Implement aether-space extension. PacketType.SpaceBreadcrumb=40. SpaceBreadcrumb model (contentHash, geoHash, anchorUhid, ttlHours, type, signature). ISpaceService (Drop/Scan/Pin/Delete). Propagation: 3-cell radius limit. Emergency type bypasses radius via ISosBroadcastService.

Implement aether-forge extension. ForgeEntry + ForgeStats models. IForgeService (Query/Cache/Fetch/GetStats). HTTP CONNECT proxy daemon in go/cmd/aether-forge-proxy/. Content-addressed via IContentService.PublishAsync().

Implement aether-vault extension. Reed-Solomon k=10 m=4 erasure coding (libfec or pure C#). VaultManifest + VaultShard models. IVaultService (Store/Recover/CheckHealth/Replicate). Shard storage via IContentService. Incentive via IAetherNetIncentiveProvider.

Implement aether-market extension. Requires Space + Vault. PoVToken (BLE co-presence, Ed25519 countersign). PoVScore (decay 6-month half-life, defection penalty 20%). MarketListing + TradeEscrow models. IPoVService + IMarketService.

Add BenchmarkDotNet performance benchmarks. Routing: AODV flood throughput, route-table lookup. Content: chunk encode/decode speed, ChunkShuffle assignment latency. Telemetry: fan-out cost (1/10/100 observers). Target: routing O(n) confirmed.
